# Russia Entry

> Independent Russia market-entry consultant for international companies. Helps brands from Turkey, South Korea, India, China, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Japan, Latin America and elsewhere decide whether Russia is worth it, choose channels, find and check distributors, and manage the market without a local team. Works only for the brand: no fees or commissions from distributors, retailers or marketplaces. Working languages: English and Russian. Async by default: a written brief, then a written plan and fixed price within 2 business days.

## Services
- [Market Intelligence](https://russiaentry.com/services.html#intelligence): market size, channels, shelf prices, grey imports, go / wait / skip recommendation. From $300.
- [Market Entry Strategy](https://russiaentry.com/services.html#strategy): entry model, factory-to-shelf price walk, EAEU certification, labelling and trademark steps, risks, 90-day plan. From $950.
- [Partner & Channel Development](https://russiaentry.com/services.html#partners): distributor long list, outreach in Russian, background checks, comparison of terms, support to first agreement. From $1,500.
- [Fractional Market Development](https://russiaentry.com/services.html#fractional): ongoing partner management, sell-out reporting, marketplace price monitoring, annual terms negotiations. From $1,000 per month.
